title: The Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission Act, 2023
titleHi: उत्तर प्रदेश शिक्षा सेवा चयन आयोग अधिनियम, 2023
sourceNote: Official India Code. The Act establishes the Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission and repeals the Uttar Pradesh Higher Education Services Commission Act, 1980, Uttar Pradesh Secondary Education Service Selection Board Act, 1982 and Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission Act, 2019, subject to savings.
